items.prior: Run samplers x JM/HMM/context matrix then test Sharpe decay WFO directly
items.current: Model-first: qualification of regime forecast model on BTCUSDT before reopening WFO
items.rationale: Prior studies (RF-05, RA-07, FP-07..09, SD-01..03) showed cadence artifacts, transition cost domination, and model degeneracy when coupling directly to WFO without proven regime predictive skill. Financial engine runs set to 0 in MF-01..MF-05.

items.prior: Primary metric was daily return / Sharpe decay across all phases
items.current: Primary metric is regime forecast quality: Multiclass Brier Skill, Balanced Accuracy, and Continuous Target MAE; Sharpe decay preserved in Section 18 WFO bridge only
items.rationale: Model forecasting accuracy on forward market conditions must be established first with proper scoring rules before evaluating parameter selection.

items.prior: V1.1 chose H90 primary and H180 secondary a priori
items.current: V1.2 compares H56 and H90 on identical origins; H* selected on Development and frozen before Test; H180 removed from active forecast roster
items.rationale: Candidate horizons 56 and 90 calendar days are evaluated empirically; H180 lookback and IS180 reference retained for features, not forecast target.

items.prior: No empirical timing or regime duration study; assumed fixed durations
items.current: Section 4D empirical regime duration: observed-state tape (OBS14_CONFIRM3_V1 vs OBS28), Kaplan-Meier survival curves, right-censoring, restricted mean survival/remaining time
items.rationale: Prevents assuming BTC has a known fixed cycle; distinguishes dwell duration, current state age, and remaining time to first exit.

items.prior: Latent state Jump Model (JM K=2) and HMM as primary classifiers
items.current: Supervised learning against realized future targets: LightGBM primary candidate, Chronos-2-Synth frozen foundation challenger, 4 statistical baselines
items.rationale: Latent models collapsed or degenerated in SD-02/SD-03; supervised targets provide objective, algorithm-independent ground truth.

items.prior: Attempted integration of external sources (CoinGecko, dominance, L2, options)
items.current: Strict exclusion of sources lacking adequate history, PIT availability, or free licensing: CoinGecko dominance, Binance BTCDOM, 1h Orderbook, Deribit options excluded; core Binance Spot/Perp/Metrics prioritized
items.rationale: Prevents auxiliary external data gaps from blocking core model qualification.

items.prior: 12 INIT + 12 VAL + 12 FINAL WFO candidate search origins
items.current: >=730 initial matured daily training origins, >=12 Development blocks (48 weekly origins), >=12 Locked Test blocks (48 weekly origins), 28-day block structure with overlap reporting and block bootstrap
items.rationale: Purely market-data-driven splits tailored for long-horizon overlapping forecasts without running candidate optimization in model phases.

items.current: WFO Bridge (Section 18) locked as CLOSED_PENDING_MODEL_QUALIFICATION_AND_OWNER; requires >=128 trials/cutoff, >=12 paired folds, and qualified forecast head to reopen
items.rationale: Preserves all Mode 4 contracts and findings while preventing premature execution.
